headline: Government allocates 550 million lei for energy compensation in the 2026 season: “We made the criteria even stricter to ensure the money goes to those people who really need it”
summary: Prime Minister Vasile Tofan said the government will apply stricter criteria for cold-season energy compensation in 2026. The state allocated 550 million lei this year.
why: Energy aid programmes shape household energy costs and public spending, which matter for Romania's fiscal outlook.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Guvernul a alocat 550 de milioane de lei pentru compensațiile la energie în sezonul 2026: „Am făcut criteriile și mai stricte ca să ne asigurăm că banii merg la acei oameni care chiar au nevoie”
